about.text: A pastry from Geraardsbergen in East Flanders, with a filling of matten, curd made by adding buttermilk to boiling whole milk, mixed with eggs, sugar and almonds. It has been an EU protected designation of origin since 2007.

sources.text: The Dutch Wikipedia articles on buttermilk, which gives the curdling and the PDO of 2007, and on the mattentaart, which gives the filling.
